Name: Device Specific Zoom
Author: cameronhimself
Description:
Do you play Stardew Valley on multiple devices with different screen sizes and resolutions? Like, say, your desktop computer and Steam Deck/laptop/tablet? Does it ever drive you insane having to set the zoom level and UI scale to comfortable values for the device you're on every time? Then this is the mod for you!

All this does is store the zoom level and UI scale in a per-device config. Set it once on your device and never think about it again. This has the added benefit of immediately saving your zoom and UI scale, rather than having to complete a day to persist your changes.


[size=4][b]FAQ:[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]I use a software tool to sync my mods folder across my devices. Will this still work?[/b]
Yes![*][b]I [i]don't[/i] use such a tool. Will this still work?[/b]
Yes![*][b]Does this work with any other settings?[/b]
No, only zoom level and UI scale for now, but if there's interest I'd be happy to expand it.[*][b]Will this conflict with any other mods?[/b]
Any mod that modifies the zoom level or UI scale will probably have some buggy interactions.[*][b]What languages are supported?[/b]
No in-game text is added or modified, so all languages are supported.[/list]

[size=4][b]Known issues:[/b][/size]

[list]
[*] If you modify your zoom level or UI scale and immediately quit without exiting the menu, your changes won't be saved.
[/list]
